title: What happens if you turn your steering wheel while driving fast?
hook: Stop turning your steering wheel too fast.

script.narration: Stop turning your steering wheel too fast.
script.visual_search: driver hands jerking steering wheel quickly

script.narration: At high speeds, a sharp yank shifts all weight to the front outside tire. This instantly overloads the contact patch and breaks traction.
script.visual_search: car tire sliding on wet asphalt close up

script.narration: Always make smooth, progressive inputs to keep your car balanced.
script.visual_search: smooth driving hands on steering wheel highway

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Do you steer smoothly? Comment yes or no, because you should...

description: Learn why sudden steering inputs at speed can cause a loss of traction. Master smooth vehicle control in under 60 seconds with Learn in 60 Seconds.
why_it_will_work: Builds directly on our best-performing short-form driving mistake videos with a clear, urgent warning hook.
